case.title: State of Wisconsin v. Brendan Dassey (2006 interrogations)
notes: Public court records. Transcripts as published at convolutedbrian.com/dassey_confessions_links.html; federal habeas decision (E.D. Wis., Aug 12, 2016) via Northwestern Law's Center on Wrongful Convictions of Youth.
The habeas grant was reversed by the Seventh Circuit en banc (Dec 8, 2017); the U.S. Supreme Court declined review (2018). This audit takes no position on guilt.

headline: Of 24 key details Brendan Dassey stated or agreed to, investigators said 13 first, 4 were already public, 1 may trace to an earlier statement with no public transcript. 6 details came from him first in the record.

fact.label: Her vehicle was in Avery's garage
fact.detail: Teresa Halbach's RAV4 (Dassey calls it 'her jeep') was parked inside Steven Avery's garage that evening.
fact.source: Decision and Order, Dassey v. Dittmann (E.D. Wis. Aug 12, 2016), p. 9, citing ECF 19-25 at 24. The vehicle's discovery on the salvage yard was public by Nov 10, 2005 (CNN); its being in the garage was not reported.

facts.why: Investigators first said it (Feb 27, 2006, Mishicot High School, p. fassbender); the suspect first adopted it after that (Feb 27, 2006, Mishicot High School, p. brendan).
